messages:
anya: Quick check — can we run a short pass on the compact rules list and keyboard flow before the release? noticed a couple of accessibility things in the prototype. mike: Yep. Saw that too. Two quick things: 1) tab order feels off when rules are collapsed, 2) drag handle isn't keyboard focusable. sam: Re: drag handle — implemented it as a div for speed. I can swap to a button, but want to confirm aria text. mike: Use a real button + aria-label. e.g. `button aria-label="Reorder rule"` and preserve the visual handle. Also ensure focus ring is visible on high-contrast mode. lex: On the compact list, when a rule preview expands it pushes content and keyboard focus sometimes lands on the wrong element. That's causing confusion in the sim. :eyes: anya: Good call. lex, can you paste the exact steps you used in the simulation? helps reproduce. lex: Steps: 1) Open policy list on small width (768px) 2) Tab to third rule 3) Press Enter to expand preview 4) Press Tab to move to reorder handle — focus jumps to body. Happens ~30% of runs. preview-bot: Simulation run complete — 30 runs, 9 failures. Mismatch: focus lost after expansion on narrow widths. Logs: `focusIndex != expectedIndex` for runs 12, 19, 23. sam: Thanks. I can repro locally. Looks like we call `focus()` on the expanded content, then animation moves layout and the subsequent tab lands incorrectly. Quick fix options: a) defer focus until animation end, b) use `aria-expanded` and keep focus on the summary button, or c) ensure a focusable element is explicitly present next in DOM. Thoughts? mike: UX preference is (b) keep focus on the summary/trigger so keyboard users know where they are, and expose a clear `aria-controls` to jump into the preview content if they want. Also update the copy for the trigger to `Show details` / `Hide details` instead of `Expand` to be clearer. anya: Agree on (b). For the drag handle aria label, suggested copy: `Move rule` and for the up/down controls (if present) `Move rule up` / `Move rule down`. keep strings short. sam: Working patch: converting the handle to `button` with `aria-label="Move rule"` and leaving `tabindex=0` on the summary. Will also add `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Posting snippet now: ```html
...preview...
``` mike: Nice. Two followups: 1) ensure the handle has `aria-grabbed` or similar when reorder mode is active (or expose a toggle to enter reorder mode), 2) strong contrast on the focus ring — 3px high-contrast outline. lex: For copy tweaks — the preview header should show a short status line `Matches: 3 / 7` and an inline help tooltip `Why this rule matched`. Keep it subtle. anya: Also add a validation message tweak: when rule priority is duplicated we currently show `Invalid priority` — propose `Two rules have the same priority. Priorities must be unique; use drag to reorder or adjust the number.` Tiny but more actionable. sam: Will update both code and validation text. I'll run the preview sim again after changes and post results. preview-bot: Scheduling re-run in 10m. Current label: `compact-rules-keyboard-flow` mike: Thanks all — small PR is fine. @sam please include a short test: keyboard nav across collapsed/expanded states + focus persistence check. :thumbsup: anya: Perfect. If re-run looks good, we'll include this in the patch cut. sam: On it, will ping when green. anya: <3
